summary.headline: Vijaya Diagnostic Q1 FY27 revenue rose 22.8% YoY to ~Rs 231 crore and EBITDA margin hit 42.7%, up 360 bps.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 22.8% YoY to ~Rs 231 crore, with test volumes up 16.5% and the balance from test mix and realisation. EBITDA rose 34% to Rs 98 crore (42.7% margin) and PAT rose 37.6% to Rs 53 crore (23% margin). Management attributed margin expansion to operating leverage in mature clusters, mainly Hyderabad growing 17%, even while absorbing the FY26 hub cohort. The company reiterated a capex plan of Rs 190-195 crore for 9 hubs, 10-12 spokes and a Panjagutta reference lab, and guided to high double-digit growth for FY27.

segments.name: Hyderabad
segments.commentary: Contributed 67% of revenue and grew 17% YoY, the main driver of operating leverage; existing spokes over 5 years old grew at higher double digits.

segments.name: Rest of AP-Telangana
segments.commentary: Contributed 20% of revenue; no growth figure disclosed.

segments.name: Pune (PH)
segments.commentary: Contributed 6% of revenue and grew ~18% YoY, from ~Rs 10.8 crore to ~Rs 12.8 crore; management expects growth to continue with 2 more hubs in 12 months.

segments.name: West Bengal
segments.commentary: Contributed 4% of revenue; Krishna Nagar hub reached breakeven in about 2 quarters.

segments.name: Mature centres vs new centres
segments.commentary: Mature centres grew 16%; new centres contributed 6-6.5% of revenue. Burn from hubs not yet at breakeven is ~0.5% of top line, under Rs 1 crore EBITDA loss in the quarter.

segments.name: Radiology and pathology
segments.commentary: Both grew; B2C was 92% of revenue and radiology 37% of revenue per the call.

guidance_outlook: FY27 growth guided to high double digits.
Mid-to-long term (3-5 years) sustainable growth of ~15% described as achievable.
EBITDA margin guided above 40%; management sees 40-45% even with a 1-1.5% drag from new hubs.
Capex of ~Rs 190-195 crore for 9 hubs, 10-12 spokes, Panjagutta reference lab and an AP land purchase (Rs 8-10 crore).
Pricing: last hike in June 2025 (Hyderabad, select tests); pricing to be reassessed after Q2/Q3.
capex_capacity: As of Q1: 166 centres (51 hubs, 115 spokes) with ~26 processing units inside hubs.
Commissioned in Q1: Gachibowli hub, Hyderabad (160-slice cardiac CT, ~Rs 9 crore capex) and 4 spokes across Hyderabad, AP and Pune; 2 more spokes in July.
JP Nagar, Bengaluru hub commissioned in July with digital PET-CT, 75 cm wide-bore 3T MR and automated central lab; capex ~Rs 30 crore.
To date toward the plan: 2 hubs and 6 spokes commissioned out of 9 hubs and 10-12 spokes planned.
Rs 190-195 crore capex plan includes the Panjagutta reference lab; 8 other hubs at ~Rs 15-16 crore each; a large automated lab planned in Pune.
demand_pricing: Growth is B2C-led; management claims 4-5 percentage points above an industry growing ~13-14%, with share gains from unorganised players.
Wellness share of revenue at ~14.8%, up from ~8% pre-COVID; packages run up to whole-body MRI/CT, typical Angio package Rs 8,000-10,000 with discounts up to ~20% of MRP.
Average tests per patient ~3.7 vs 2.5-3 at pure pathology chains; revenue per footfall Rs 1,860 vs Rs 900-950 at acute pathology chains.
Management sees no deep discounting; B2B share at peers 25-30% at lower prices, cited for Vijaya's higher margins.
Competition: no large integrated networks in Hyderabad/AP/Telangana; Bengaluru market fragmented into local chains of 5-6 centres.

qa_highlights.question: Breakdown of 166 centres and whether collection centres are included?
qa_highlights.answer: 51 hubs and 115 spokes, with ~26 processing units inside hubs; no plain collection centres, every spoke has at least ECG or X-ray.

qa_highlights.question: Capex for the two hubs commissioned this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: JP Nagar Bengaluru ~Rs 30 crore (commissioned July); Gachibowli Hyderabad ~Rs 9 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Would margins hold at ~40% with the expansion plan?
qa_highlights.answer: Operating leverage from mature clusters offsets drag; hub drag was ~0.5% last year, and management is confident of above 40% even with 1-1.5% drag from new hubs.

qa_highlights.question: Why buy land in AP rather than lease?
qa_highlights.answer: Leased sites could not be secured for a location targeted for 5-7 years; land is ~Rs 8-10 crore and is included in the Rs 190 crore capex.

qa_highlights.question: Is 20% growth a new normal?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says high double-digit growth for FY27 and ~15% sustainable over 3-5 years; Q1 grew 23%.

qa_highlights.question: Why are standalone pathology margins lower than Vijaya's?
qa_highlights.answer: Peers have 25-30% B2B business at discounted prices; Vijaya also has higher tests per patient and revenue per footfall.

risks_watch: Margin dilution as the 9 new hubs ramp up; management guides a 1-1.5% drag.
Pune growth is flat at ~6% of revenue; the new Pune automated lab and 2 hubs are needed to show acceleration.
Bengaluru is still early; JP Nagar lab accreditation and the hub/spoke build-out depend on it.
Rs 190-195 crore capex execution is phased; the staggering of hub launches could shift quarterly numbers.
No price hike since June 2025 (limited to Hyderabad); pricing reassessment after Q2/Q3.
Data monetisation is under consideration only; compliance path not defined and no data is shared today.
summary.management_tone: Confident and specific on growth, margin and the expansion pipeline, with numbers given for most questions. Cautious on Pune's pace and on data monetisation, where the answers were non-committal.
key_quotes: We're fairly confident of giving high double digit growth for FY27.
So even if you get like a 40% to 45%, even if there's a drag from the Future expansion, another one, one and a half percent, we are fairly confident of achieving the above 40% EBITDA margin.
We don't do plain collection centre formats at all.
As of today, as Vijaya is a company, we do not share this data.

financial_highlights.change: Flat vs last year's 14.8% per analyst

adds.what: Gachibowli hub, Hyderabad (160-slice cardiac CT, ~Rs 9 crore capex) plus 4 spokes across Hyderabad, AP and Pune commissioned in Q1
JP Nagar, Bengaluru hub commissioned in July with PET-CT, 3T MR and automated central lab
9 hub centres, 10-12 spoke centres and Panjagutta reference lab under Rs 190-195 cr capex plan (8 other hubs at ~Rs 15-16 cr each; large automated lab in Pune);

growth.why: Management guides high double-digit FY27 revenue growth (midpoint ~15% used as a conservative figure for the 'high double digit' phrasing is not exact; recorded as 15 for the 3-5 year ~15% view) and EBITDA margin above 40%, backed by a Rs 190-195 cr capex plan for 9 hubs and 10-12 spokes of which 2 hubs and 6 spokes are already commissioned, plus Q1 revenue growth of 22.8% and volume growth of 16.
